help: Adds the specified number of every fish species to the player fleet's cargo.

Adds fish to your cargo. Enter an exact ID or full name; both autocomplete, and names do not need quotes. Quantity must be a positive whole number. Leaving it out adds one fish. Supply optional arguments in the order shown. Quality sets size: 0 is the species minimum and 1 is its maximum. Without a quality value, each fish gets a random size. Coherence ranges from 0 (none) to 1 (fully coherent) and defaults to the species midpoint. Example: addfish False Dawn 3 0.8 1
Spawns the selected fish in a nearby open rupture or under the active breach lamps. Supports repeatable legendary chase testing.
Spawns the visiting Fisherman in the player's current star system.
Spawns a route-backed scavenger with the selected local fleet quest. Available only inside a star system; quest ids autocomplete.
Spawns the selected framework or vanilla distress call. Available only in hyperspace; event ids autocomplete.
Displays legendary chase state: host, provocation, sightings, active motes, and haunt status.
